name: DH-5-6
summary: DH-5-6 is DH-Robotics' five-finger dexterous hand for coordinated robotic grasping and manipulation development. It combines six active degrees of freedom with 11 total degrees of freedom in a manufacturer-listed 790 g hand. The official specification gives a 0.8-second cycle time, 24 V operation and Modbus RTU or a proprietary RS485 protocol. Optional tactile arrays on the fingertips and palm add contact perception for adaptive gripping. The manufacturer separates a 25 N fingertip force from an 80 N five-finger gripping force and a 10 kg payload.
